series.summary: Emma and Norman break the rules to return Conny’s forgotten toy, discovering her murdered body and learning their loving mother is raising them as food for monsters.

title: The Dark Secret Behind The Gate Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: Six-year-old Conny hugs her stuffed toy Little Bunny tightly as she prepares to leave Grace Field House forever. Surrounded by cheering younger siblings, she promises to write frequent letters and never forget her family. Mother Isabella stands beside her, wearing a gentle smile as she guides the little girl toward the door. To the children, this joyful farewell marks the start of a wonderful new life. Yet beneath this peaceful scene lies an ominous mystery. What dark reality awaits beyond the orphanage gates?

Shortly after the farewell, Emma discovers that Conny left Little Bunny behind on the dining room table. The distant gate lights remain illuminated, showing the exit has not yet closed. Emma knows Conny cannot leave without her most cherished possession. Together, Emma and Norman grab the stuffed rabbit and slip out into the pitch-black night. Defying the orphanage’s strictest rule never to approach the fence, they sprint straight toward the forbidden forest. Can they reach the gate in time?

Emerging from the dense trees, Emma and Norman reach the towering perimeter wall. To their shock, the colossal iron gate stands unlocked and wide open. The children cautiously step inside the cold, shadowy tunnel, searching for any sign of their departed sister. Parked in the gloom rests an unfamiliar motor vehicle they have never encountered before. A suffocating silence hangs over the empty tunnel. Emma calls out Conny’s name into the darkness, but only chilling echoes answer back.

Stepping toward the rear of the vehicle, Emma lifts the heavy canvas curtain and peeks inside the cargo bed. In a single instant, pure terror paralyzes her. Lying pale and lifeless in the darkness is Conny, with a blood-red flower pierced through her chest. Emma gasps in absolute horror, stumbling backward as Little Bunny drops from her trembling hands. The horrifying truth crashes down upon them. This was never an adoption.

Suddenly, heavy footsteps and demonic voices echo down the corridor, forcing Emma and Norman to dive beneath the vehicle. Towering, grotesque monsters emerge from the shadows, casually discussing human meat and admiring the farm’s top-quality shipment. Then, Mother Isabella steps forward, calmly addressing the creatures and promising them the highest-scoring children next. Emma and Norman clutch their mouths in silent agony as the chilling reality sets in. Trapped beneath the truck inches away from slaughter, will Emma and Norman escape the demons without being noticed?
